title: The normalized Hom comparison intertwines signed evaluation
statement: In the ordinary point-extension models [def-pod-point-derived-hom-models], suppose the adjunction is explicit, c is any module complex and I any sheaf-module complex. Every chain isomorphism q:sections Hom_B(Lc,I) to Hom_R(c,sections I) satisfying IsComparison also satisfies EvaluationCompatible: there exist the ordinary sheaf evaluation, sections-tensor map and ordinary module evaluation with their prescribed signed formulas, and beta followed by sections(e_B) equals (id_c tensor q) followed by e_R.

proof.text: Take the sheaf evaluation and beta of the sheaf construction and the ordinary module signed evaluation.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: Use total coproduct extensionality and generation of each module tensor by pure tensors. On x tensor h, beta followed by sections(e_B) equals (-1)^(pj)h_p(1 tensor x). Naturality of total tensor inserts q_j(h) on the other side, and its evaluation is the same by IsComparison. Thus the chain maps agree.
